doc.title: Sheila Jordan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Where she lived in Detroit
summary: She locates her home near Woodward Avenue and John R, with Cameron Brown commenting as a fellow Detroiter.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And when you were living in Detroit, what neighborhood did you live in?

We were pretty close to John R. There was Woodward Avenue. We were close to Woodward Avenue on the other side. And then, I think, if you went another block or two, it was, uh, John R, I think. I think so. I‟m looking over at… Cameron Brown‟s here.
Yeah. Brown, C.: [You were?] downtown. So you were…
Yeah. Brown, C.: You were virtually right downtown.
I was on Woodward Avenue and, uh… I can‟t remember the other street. But yeah, I could practically walk down there. Oh, there‟s so many stories about Detroit before I left there.
